name: Index Law
long_description:
Index Law is building Mike-1, a superhuman AI lawyer*! Mike is an AI legal agent that gives every business the capabilities of a world-class legal team. 

Unlike traditional legal AI tools that help lawyers work faster, Mike gets legal work done directly for your business. It understands your business, reviews and negotiates contracts, handles corporate matters, and brings in vetted human lawyers when specialist expertise is needed.

Your documents, agreements, signatures, and legal history live in one workspace. Mike remembers your business and becomes more useful with every matter.

We're starting with contracts and corporate work for startups and growing businesses. Early customers have turned around contracts in under an hour and received quotes up to 80% below traditional law firm alternatives.

Our ambition is to make legal services work like software: instantly accessible, deeply personalized, and capable of handling increasingly complex work.

Try Mike: https://usemike.com

*Note: Mike-1 is an AI legal agent, not a licensed or practicing lawyer. Qualified human lawyers provide legal advice and representation where required.

launches.title: Meet Mike-1: Your company's AI lawyer
launches.tagline: An AI legal agent that gets work done, with exceptional human lawyers when you need them.
launches.body:
Hey YC! I’m Quddus. I spent the last few years spending millions on legal fees, from navigating a difficult family legal battle to later, the AI company I started in high school reaching $20M+ in booked revenues, only to be upended when we couldn’t afford the legal help we needed.

I’ve experienced this problem as a son, and as a founder. **I’m building the legal team I wish we’d had.**

Today we’re launching **Mike-1**. ([usemike.com](https://usemike.com))

**TL;DR:** At Index Law (F26), we’re attempting to build a superhuman lawyer! Mike-1 is an AI legal agent built that understands your business, gets contracts and corporate work done, and brings in vetted human lawyers when needed. Our ambition is to make the capabilities of a great law firm available as software.

We're already working with startups and larger companies, turning around contracts in under an hour and helping customers save up to 80% compared with traditional legal quotes.

<https://youtu.be/nmJhvLenZKk>

### **⚖️ The Problem**

**Legal help is still slow, expensive, and difficult to access. AI hasn't fundamentally changed the client experience.**

Finding a good lawyer is hard. Knowing whether they're good is harder. You pay by the hour, explain your business repeatedly, and manage the process yourself.

Legal AI has largely taken two approaches:

1. **AI for lawyers:** Harvey and Legora make lawyers more productive. The benefits primarily accrue to law firms, increases their margins but I haven’t seen any of my bills—as a client—reduce.
2. **AI-native law firms:** AI startups that are regulated law firms are making legal services faster and more affordable, but largely retain the traditional service model.

We think there’s a third, bigger opportunity: **make the law firm itself work like software.**

Instead of finding, hiring, and managing lawyers, imagine simply telling an AI agent what you need done. It knows your business, handles the work, brings in great lawyers when needed, and gets better with every matter. **The goal is to not just be cheaper & faster than traditional law-firms, it’s to be truly better.** 

\
We don’t want to build a law-firm, we want to build what comes after!

### **🤖 Meet Mike-1: Your company's AI lawyer**

Mike isn't another legal chatbot. \*It’s also not a practicing lawyer; it's an AI legal agent connected to your company's documents, legal work, and a network of experienced, real human lawyers it can speak to in order to get work done.

Say you're closing a $200k customer contract or a $10M round:

* **Ask Mike to handle it.** It reviews the agreement, understands your company's priorities, explains the risks, and prepares redlines. You don't need to know what to ask or which clauses to look for.
* **Go from advice to action.** Mike helps negotiate the terms, revise the document, and get it ready for signature. You can review and approve the work along the way.
* **Get a real lawyer when needed.** Mike can bring in a vetted specialist, including former BigLaw attorneys, with the context and documents already prepared.
* **Never start from scratch.** Your contracts, negotiations, signatures, and company knowledge live in one place. Mike remembers what matters and uses it in future work.

**The difference: you don't just ask Mike legal questions. You give Mike legal work to do.**

We're starting with contracts and corporate work for startups and growing businesses.

We've already helped turn around contracts in under an hour and quoted legal work at up to 80% below traditional law firm alternatives. You can also use Mike directly, or have it work alongside your existing lawyers or a “forward-deployed lawyer” from us.

### 📈 Early results

We're already working with startups and larger companies:

* **Under 60 minutes** to turn around a customer contract that would normally take days.
* **Up to 80% lower quotes** than traditional law firms for comparable legal work by comparable partners.
* **Beyond one-off reviews:** Supporting ongoing contracts, corporate matters, and transactions.

The interesting part isn't just saving money. It's helping companies close deals faster and get legal support on decisions they might otherwise make without it.

### 🔬 The bigger bet

**We think the next great legal company will look more like a software company than a law firm.**

At Index Law, we're building the intelligence behind Mike: agents that understand a business, reason through legal consequences, remember past decisions, and carry work through to completion.

The hard problem isn't generating legal text. It's knowing which decisions are right, why, and when to involve a human.

Our long-term goal is a superhuman legal agent backed by a global network of exceptional lawyers. Each matter makes Mike more useful to your business.

\*\*Not just cheaper legal work. Better legal judgment, available to everyone.\*\*\
\
🙏 Asks

* **Founders / GCs :** Have a contract to negotiate, a round to close, or corporate work slowing you down? We'd love to help. Reach out at [q@indexlaw.com](mailto:q@indexlaw.com) or book a time here: <https://cal.com/mike1/mike-1-setup>
* **Lawyers:** We're building a network of exceptional counsel who want to work alongside AI and reach more clients. If you know any lawyers who would like more clients, and are well referenced: please share my email or share more details here: <https://lawyers.usemike.com>\
  \
  \*Note: _Mike-1 is an AI legal agent, not a licensed or practicing lawyer. It assists with legal research, drafting, review, and workflows, with qualified human lawyers involved where professional legal advice or representation is required._
